name: ESPectre Wi-Fi Motion Detection
description: The selects change the traffic source, the detection algorithm, and the CSI sample spacing at runtime. They are configuration entities. All keys are optional, but configure at least one per platform entry.

config_entries.label: Espectre ID
config_entries.description: ID of the ESPectre component. Automatically selected when omitted.

config_entries.label: Csi Sample Spacing
config_entries.description: Options `half_slot` and `distinct`. See [`csi_sample_spacing`](https://esphome.io/components/espectre/#configuration-variables).

config_entries.label: Name
config_entries.description: The name for the select. At least one of **id** and **name** must be specified.

config_entries.label: Icon
config_entries.description: Manually set the icon to use for the select in the frontend.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the ID for code generation. At least one of **id** and **name** must be specified.

config_entries.label: Disabled By Default
config_entries.description: If true, then this entity should not be added to any client's frontend, (usually Home Assistant) without the user manually enabling it (via the Home Assistant UI). Defaults to `false`.

config_entries.label: Entity Category
config_entries.description: The category of the entity. See [https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/core/entity/#generic-properties](https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/core/entity/#generic-properties) for a list of available options. Set to `""` to remove the default entity category.

config_entries.label: Internal
config_entries.description: Mark this component as internal. Internal components will not be exposed to the frontend (like Home Assistant). Only specifying an `id` without a `name` will implicitly set this to true.

config_entries.label: Detection Algorithm
config_entries.description: Options `lightweight` and `high_accuracy`. The threshold changes to the default of the new algorithm. Switching to `lightweight` starts a calibration, so keep the room still until it finishes.

config_entries.label: Traffic Generator Mode
config_entries.description: Options `ping`, `dns`, `dns_tcp`, `wifi_raw`, and `external`. See [Traffic Sources](https://esphome.io/components/espectre/#traffic-sources). `wifi_raw` is not offered on ESP32-C6 or with `csi_capture_profile: ht_vht`. `traffic_generator_target_ip` applies only to `ping`, `dns`, and `dns_tcp`. Changing the mode restarts Lightweight calibration. High Accuracy keeps its threshold.
